{{Top|leg}}
A '''vacuum-wrapped parcel''' was a method of storing types of food or other perishable items in an airless environment, usually in an air-tight pack or container to prevent the growth of microorganisms. The [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] environment removed atmospheric [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], protecting the object from spoiling by limiting the growth of aerobic bacteria or [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]], and preventing the evaporation of volatile components.
